fullPassage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world, even in large cities, is still walking because of constraints on the resources needed to operate extensive transit systems. People cover long distances on foot every day and expend human energy that they can hardly spare. Walking under those conditions is an unavoidable burden that consumes productive capability. In North America and Western Europe, however, the attitude and policies are just the opposite: walking is efficient, healthful, and natural. We should do more of it — almost everybody agrees — and some of the current trends should be reversed. Ironically, among the most popular exercise machines in health clubs and in homes are tread-mills that simulate walking, which could be otherwise accomplished with a transport purpose on the street.

questions.passage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world is still walking because of constraints on the resources ①<u>needed</u> to operate extensive transit systems. People ②<u>covering</u> long distances on foot every day and ③<u>expend</u> human energy that they can hardly ④<u>spare</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② covering → cover: 주절 본동사 필요 (People cover).
det.analysis:
❌ ② covering: 본동사 필요 → People cover
✅ ① needed: 과거분사(수동) 정상
✅ ③ expend: and expend(병렬) 정상
✅ ④ spare: can + 동사원형 정상

questions.passage: Walking under those conditions is an unavoidable burden that ①<u>consumes</u> productive capability. In North America, the attitude is just the opposite: walking is ②<u>efficient</u>, healthful, and natural. We should do more of it — almost everybody ③<u>agree</u>. Some of the current trends should be ④<u>reversed</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ agree → agrees: everybody(단수) → 3인칭 단수 동사.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ agree: everybody(단수) → agrees
✅ ① consumes: burden(단수) 정상
✅ ② efficient: 형용사 정상
✅ ④ reversed: should be reversed(수동) 정상

questions.passage: Ironically, among the most popular exercise machines in health clubs are tread-mills that ①<u>simulate</u> walking, ②<u>which</u> could be otherwise ③<u>accomplishing</u> with a transport purpose on the ④<u>street</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ accomplishing → accomplished: be + 과거분사(수동) 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ accomplishing: could be accomplished(수동) 필요
✅ ① simulate: 복수 주어 정상
✅ ② which: 관계대명사 정상
✅ ④ street: 명사 정상
det.tip: could be accomplished = 달성될 수 있는 (수동)

✅ ③ unavoidable: 원문 일치
✅ ④ consumes: 원문 일치

❌ ② less: 원문 more → 더 많이
